projects.title: LUXE WASH
projects.desc: A demo website for a premium car detailing studio in Algiers: a scroll-driven intro, services with prices, and booking.
projects.story: LUXE WASH is a demo where I pushed animation and polish as far as I could. I wanted it to feel premium.

projects.title: DN Couture
projects.desc: A website for a sewing and tailoring tutor: sessions and workshops, the tutor's story and sewing guides, in English, French and Arabic.
projects.story: DN Couture is a real website for a sewing tutor, in three languages. Building for a real person feels different.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.desc: This site: a multilingual Angular portfolio with right-to-left support and a day/night theme.
projects.story: You're inside this one! Angular, four languages, and me as the moon.

projects.title: Loan Management
projects.desc: A loan management system with an Angular frontend and a Spring Boot backend on MySQL.
projects.story: Loan Management was my beginning with Spring Boot. It proved to me that I can build a complete app, front to back.

projects.title: Movies Watchlist API
projects.desc: A REST API for a movie watchlist, built with Spring Boot for learning.
projects.story: I built the Watchlist API at university. It's simple, I know, but I was proud of it then and I still am.

projects.title: Library Management
projects.desc: A library management system built with JEE, JavaScript and MySQL.
projects.story: Library Management goes back to my studies. That's where I realised I love Java.

jobs.desc: Designing and implementing software solutions for geophysical operations and internal systems.

jobs.desc: Software integration and development for port management systems.
jobs.story: At APCS Serports I went professional with Spring Boot. A big step for me, and a great experience.

jobs.desc: Developed and maintained software components; contributed to solution design and debugging.
jobs.story: Compos Solution was my first professional experience: real projects, inside a professional team.

jobs.desc: National service: discipline, coordination and operations.
jobs.story: National service was an obligation I had to fulfil. It taught me discipline and coordination.

jobs.desc: Taught academic courses and helped students with theory and practice.
jobs.story: I was a university teacher, and I loved it. That's where I found out how much I enjoy sharing knowledge.
